name: Hair Spray
description: Guidelines for traveling with hair spray in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Hairspray (aerosol or pump) is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Cans in carry-on must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

checkedBag.reason: Hairspray is allowed in checked baggage up to capacity limits for personal aerosols (max 18 oz per container, 70 oz total per passenger).

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring hair spray on a plane?

faq.question: Is hair spray allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Hair Spray is restricted in carry-on luggage. Hairspray (aerosol or pump) is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Cans in carry-on must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.question: Can you pack hair spray in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Hair Spray is allowed in checked bags. Hairspray is allowed in checked baggage up to capacity limits for personal aerosols (max 18 oz per container, 70 oz total per passenger).
